A '''pressor generator''' was a device that utilized [[pressor field]]s used by [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]] in order to stop [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] during surgery. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the pressor generator used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]] was frequently broken during the [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MBS" />
